subject.title: Feature Request: Masked Secrets - Prevent Agent from Accessing Raw API Keys

question: Should OpenClaw support selected credentials that approved tools can use but the general agent shell and model cannot read?
rationale: This changes the documented single-operator authority model and introduces compatibility-sensitive core and plugin contracts, so automation cannot safely choose the boundary.

options.title: Isolated capability injection
options.body: Add a narrow core broker seam for isolated executors or outbound request owners without returning raw values to the agent.

options.title: External isolation only
options.body: Keep core focused on SecretRef storage and redaction, with separate users, sandboxes, services, or plugins as the confidentiality boundary.

options.title: Best-effort masking
options.body: Add placeholders and output masking while explicitly documenting that they do not form a security boundary.

recommendation.title: Isolated capability injection
recommendation.body: Add a narrow core broker seam for isolated executors or outbound request owners without returning raw values to the agent.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the relevant security model, source, configuration, and documentation surfaces to this team.
